verdict.rationale: Kit documents webhooks that notify an integration of account activity in real time (kit-docs-21). Every delivery is signed with the endpoint secret (kit-docs-24), and failed deliveries are retried with backoff (kit-docs-40). However, nothing in the pack says which event types can be subscribed to, so delivery and engagement events are unconfirmed; engagement stats appear only as pull-based broadcast stats API endpoints. Missing for 10: evidence of webhook events for sends, opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscribes; a documented payload schema; independent or hands-on corroboration.
